_doc: Lagu unit Deria (DSKP hlm. 38). Baris 1,2,4: 3+2+2+2+2+2 suku kata (Ke-pa-la, ba-hu, lu-tut, ka-ki, lu-tut, ka-ki); baris 3: 9 suku kata (Ma-ta, te-li-nga, mu-lut, hi-dung). Gaya: --style=tadika|joget (tools/songs/make_song.py STYLES). Sebutan baku.
title: Lihat, Dengar, Hidu, Rasa
caption: slow gentle Malaysian children's song, {style}, sung in standard Malaysian Malay (sebutan baku), clear Malaysian diction, not Indonesian, {voice}, easy for 7-year-olds to sing along, warm and cheerful, major key

voices.female: warm clear female voice, Malaysian kindergarten teacher
voices.male: friendly clear male voice, Malaysian primary school teacher

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lihatlah, dengar, hidu, rasa, hidu, rasa
Lihatlah, dengar, hidu, rasa, hidu, rasa
Mata, telinga, hidung, lidah
Lihatlah, dengar, hidu, rasa, sentuh, sentuh!

[Verse 2]
Matanya warna, saiz, bentuk, saiz, bentuk
Telinga bunyi, hidung bau, hidung bau
Lidahnya rasa manis, masam
Kulitnya kasar, licin, lembut, keras, sentuh!

[Verse 3]
Cermin mata bantu lihat, bantu lihat
Alat bantu, bantu dengar, bantu dengar
Gelap-gelita, guna sentuh
Deria lain boleh bantu, boleh bantu!
